description: Build an unsigned mint for the canonical LINK and SDL Uniswap V3 LP NFT. This does not include NFT staking.

allow_zero_mins.description: Set true to explicitly acknowledge zero minimums if you are not providing min amounts.

amount_link.description: LINK leg amount in human-readable form.

amount_link_min.description: Optional minimum LINK to deploy into the position. Provide together with amount_sdl_min.

amount_sdl.description: SDL leg amount in human-readable form.

amount_sdl_min.description: Optional minimum SDL to deploy into the position. Provide together with amount_link_min.

name: sdl_build_uniswap_v3_lp
